title: Christmas Lucky Block
description: This Christmas-themed Lucky Block adds 30 different events!
body:
![Title (Christmas Lucky block)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39c8dbe6ef0f803656c2b3fa7401eacae54f381f.png)

Welcome to the Christmas Lucky Block mod! Bring the holiday spirit—and a touch of unpredictable chaos—to your Minecraft world. Break the festive blocks and discover if Santa Claus left you a legendary gift or a dangerous holiday surprise!

✨ Features
The Christmas Lucky Block: A brand new, beautifully textured block covered in holiday wrapping.

Custom Loot Tables: Dozens of unique drops, ranging from powerful festive gear to tricky traps.

Holiday Weapons & Tools: Unleash the power of Christmas with unique items (e.g., Candy Cane swords, snowball launchers, or tnt gift).

**here are a few examples:**

![delimitation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3511c771023c56c24fbb1d2c5178582683951d79.png)
![Title : The snowball cannon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eda277d7dd8ff11ad8225a241f6b44fc44ea0804.png)

The Snowball Cannon has a progressive firing power; depending on the charging time (similar to the bow),but it's not primarily designed to deal heavy damage. Instead, its main purpose is to push enemies back.

![Image of the snowball cannon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/876b37037cef9f278b23a7b97866bc260c79fc73_0.webp)

![delimitation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3511c771023c56c24fbb1d2c5178582683951d79.png)

![Title : Hot chocolate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45d4226a535a5a05e37851d1219595340ad70b3e.png)

Hot chocolate warms you up by giving you various effects, such as increased speed and more.

![Image : Hot chocolate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f90cb84c0fc9cc2ea92a955ba95b651c91bcb39_0.webp)

![delimitation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3511c771023c56c24fbb1d2c5178582683951d79.png)

![Title : TNT Gift](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9caf53bba6f1ff87fdbcf014a4c768ed1ace672b.png)

The TNT Gift can be thrown at medium range, exploding upon impact with the ground or a mob and causing massive explosion damage. (Handle with care!) Be careful not to confuse it with the presents meant for your kids...

![Image : TNT GIFT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dcebdbf596aed7502a73bd14212c605c35ec67d3_0.webp)

![delimitation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3511c771023c56c24fbb1d2c5178582683951d79.png)

🎲 30 Unique Festive Events!
Get ready for ultimate chaos! The mod features 30 completely custom events that can trigger every time you break a block. From unexpected windfalls to sudden dangers, every single outcome is designed to keep you on your toes. Gather your friends, brace yourselves, and see if luck is on your side for the holidays!
